title: Show HN: I wrote a C++ ray tracer from scratch without AI
summary: A developer built a complete C++ ray tracer from scratch without using AI tools, sharing it as a Hacker News Show HN post. The project demonstrates traditional graphics programming skills, with the author intentionally highlighting that no AI assistance was used during development.
problem_solved: Implements ray tracing algorithms from scratch to render photorealistic images with lighting, shadows, and reflections.
why_valuable: Demonstrates pure coding competency and deep understanding of computer graphics fundamentals in an era where AI-assisted development is increasingly common.
